name: Asset Alchemist
title: Cinematic Dominion — Personal Premiere & Entertainment Redesign
subtitle: Cinematic homepage, featured personal films, real local posters and immersive responsive visuals
features: A dramatic responsive Premiere homepage highlights a real saved local video, its poster and its existing resume progress.
A personal filmstrip makes up to four additional videos available for immediate handoff to the existing Video Vault player.
Uses the user's own high-quality Vault posters and the small JPEG still of a saved personal cover; does not autoplay animated art or clone original movie files.
One-tap play/resume and alternate spotlight reuse the existing Video Vault watch event; no duplicate library or new save format.
Full-site dark violet, cyan and gold cinematic visual system refines Command Center, navigation, media art, studio cards and mobile dock.
Cinematic atmosphere on/off is stored as a small browser preference with reduced-motion support, without altering personal background or thumbnail files.
Existing 18 studios, original library, OPFS/IndexedDB media, favorite and resume metadata, Home Screen Icon Studio, web-app installation and offline rollback remain unchanged.
